providers.name: gemini
providers.description: Google Gemini / Gemma via the Gemini API (GEMINI_API_KEY); free tier available

providers.name: litellm
providers.description: Any of LiteLLM's 100+ providers (pip install litellm); e.g. litellm:anthropic/claude-3-5-haiku-latest

providers.name: ollama
providers.description: Local models via Ollama (OLLAMA_BASE_URL, default http://localhost:11434/v1); always $0

providers.name: openai
providers.description: OpenAI or any OpenAI-compatible API (OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_BASE_URL)

providers.name: openrouter
providers.description: OpenRouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY), hundreds of models incl. free ones

scorers.name: auto
scorers.description: tool_call_match for tool-calling steps, json_match for JSON outputs, else pairwise_judge when a judge model is configured, else similarity

scorers.name: exact_match
scorers.description: 1 if the candidate output equals the original (whitespace/case/quote-insensitive)

scorers.name: json_match
scorers.description: Share of the original JSON's (flattened) fields the candidate reproduces exactly; 0 if not valid JSON

scorers.name: pairwise_judge
scorers.description: LLM judge scores original vs candidate side by side (order randomized to avoid position bias)

config.name: criteria
config.description: Extra task-specific criteria for the judge

scorers.name: similarity
scorers.description: Token-overlap F1 between candidate and original output (cheap, no LLM)

scorers.name: tool_call_match
scorers.description: Tool-calling steps: does the candidate make the same decision (call vs answer), call the same tools in the same order with the same arguments? Final-answer turns fall back to a text scorer; judge_weight blends both

config.name: args_mode
config.description: lenient (key order, case, whitespace, '5' vs 5) | strict (exact JSON) | partial (field overlap)

config.name: weights
config.description: Weights of the sub-scores when the decision matches

config.name: ignore_args
config.description: Argument names (or tool.arg) to leave out, e.g. free-text search queries

config.name: judge_weight
config.description: 0..1: blend in a text scorer on the assistant text (0 = tool calls only)

config.name: text_scorer
config.description: Scorer for final answers / the blended text part

scorers.name: eval:<evaluator>
scorers.description: Reuse any evaluator: llm_correctness, llm_faithfulness, llm_relevance, llm_rubric, llm_toxicity, contains, exact_match, json_valid, latency_budget, length, regex, similarity

samplers.name: random
samplers.description: A uniform random sample of N distinct prompts (seeded, so runs are reproducible)

samplers.name: recent
samplers.description: The most recent N distinct prompts

samplers.name: stratified
samplers.description: Spread evenly over time and prompt length, so rare long prompts are represented

policies.name: budget
policies.description: Highest-quality candidate that reaches a target cost reduction

config.name: min_quality
config.description: Never accept average relative quality below this

policies.name: quality_threshold
policies.description: Cheapest candidate whose average relative quality stays within max_quality_drop of the original

config.name: min_savings_pct
config.description: Only recommend switches that save at least this much

config.name: max_latency_increase_pct
config.description: Optional: reject candidates slower than this (e.g. 50)

config.name: min_tool_agreement
config.description: Tool-calling steps: share of replays where the candidate makes the same tool calls (names, order, arguments) as the original; null disables

policies.name: weighted
policies.description: Maximize quality_weight·quality + cost_weight·savings (+ latency_weight·speedup); switch only if it beats the original
